from typing import Annotated
from typing import Any

from pydantic import BaseModel
from pydantic import Field

from voice_agent.schemas.candidate_datapoint import CandidateDatapointDefinition

from .task import TaskConfiguration


class JobContext(BaseModel):
    """Context about the job position being discussed."""

    title: str = Field(description="Title of the job position")
    description: str = Field(description="Detailed description of the job position")
    company: str = Field(description="Company offering the job position")
    location: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Location of the job position"
    )
    contract_type: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Type of contract (W2, 1099, etc)"
    )
    start_date: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Expected start date for the job position"
    )
    schedule: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Schedule information for the job position"
    )


class CallScriptContext(BaseModel):
    """Context for Call Script"""

    job: JobContext = Field(description="the job position being discussed.")
    candidate: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="Any datapoint collected for the candidate prior to the call",
    )
    knowledge_base: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict, description="Knowledge base for the job position"
    )


class CallScript(BaseModel):
    """Script for an AI faciliated call with candidates. This object will be immutable"""

    id: str = Field(description="Unique identifier for the call script")
    call_script_schema_version: str = Field(
        description="Version of the call script schema"
    )
    call_script_version: str = Field(description="Version of the call script")

    candidate_data_point_schemas: dict[str, CandidateDatapointDefinition] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="dictionary of all candidate datapoint schemas referenced in the call script",
    )
    context: CallScriptContext = Field(description="Context for the call script")

    tasks: list[
        Annotated[TaskConfiguration, Field(discriminator="task_agent_type")]
    ] = Field(default_factory=list, description="List of call node configurations")
